title: Chaos Erupts as Step-Mom Fires Gun At Real Mom with Child in Car
description: On June 16th, 2024. Officers were on a traffic stop when they heard a gun shot coming from a nearby location. Upon arrival they learnt that a woman had fired a gun at another woman who was there to pick up her child from her baby-daddy. The child had stated that his step mom had threated to beat his ass and then tell her mama. Upon learning that information, the real mom got angry when she was there to pick her child and that's when all hell broke lose. The baby-daddy also got in the mix when he choked his ex-girlfriend. This is the footage of how things went down.
